member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Utilities.Utilities.UpdateSpecialCharacters(System.String)
member.summary: Method to update special characters in strings. This method handles the conversion of special characters similar to Update-M365DSCSpecialCharacters. This function updates special characters in a string to be escaped in a DSC configuration. The function replaces the following characters: - 0x201C = “ - 0x201D = ” - 0x201E = „
member.returns: The processed string with special characters updated
